newsitem.title: UK: Food retailers firm as Kleinwort repeats "buy".
newsitem.headline: Food retailers firm as Kleinwort repeats "buy".

text.p: Shares in Tesco, Sainsbury and Safeway were higher on Thursday amid a food retail sector review by Kleinwort Benson and as analysts at the brokerage repeated a "buy" recommendation on the sector. Tesco Plc put on 4-1/2p to 343p, J Sainsbury was up 3p at 369p and Safeway Plc gained 4-1/2p to 384p by 1105 GMT.
Kleinwort Benson analyst Simon Dunn repeated his positive stance on the sector today ahead of the new year.
"Margin background is improving, thanks to petrol and currency," Dunn said. "Demand is strengthening and we think the recent outperformance is fully justified," he added.
"But with earnings momentum improving we think the sector has considerably further to go," Dunn said, adding that his profit forecasts and share price targets remained unchanged.
